title: Lab trends
description: The lab trend lines the panel draws, one per test (LOINC code and unit), built by LabTrends from the same lab rows the fact table reads. Display data, never a fact: not in the facts hash or the prompt. A point read from an uploaded document carries its document citation; a point entered in the chart carries null. At most 6 series (most recently resulted first) of 2 to 8 points (oldest first); more counts the series left out.

name.description: The latest point's test name as recorded.

unit.description: The latest point's unit as recorded; may be empty.
